messages.content: What is Ergovia-AI?

Ergovia-AI is a comprehensive AI-powered productivity platform that offers two main services: 1) A personal AI assistant (TaskAI) for productivity, marketing, and business operations, and 2) Ergovia TaskForce (ETF) - white-label automation solutions for businesses. Visit https://ergovia-ai.com to get started.
What services does Ergovia offer?

Ergovia offers: 1) Personal AI Assistant - Help with affiliate marketing, content creation, task automation, and business operations. 2) Ergovia TaskForce (ETF) - Ready-to-deploy automation workflows for pet clinics, gyms, contractors, tutoring services, and massage therapy businesses. 3) White-label AI agency solutions - Start your own AI agency with our tools running 24/7 under your brand.
How do I sign up for Ergovia?

To sign up for Ergovia-AI: 1) Visit https://ergovia-ai.com 2) Click the signup button or go to https://ergovia-ai.com/signup 3) Sign up with your Google account 4) Complete your profile setup. You'll get free access to start, with premium features available for $30/month.
What is Ergovia TaskForce?

Ergovia TaskForce (ETF) is our white-label automation solution that provides ready-to-deploy business workflows. We offer specialized packages for: Pet Clinics, Gyms & Fitness Centers, Contractors & HVAC, Tutoring Services, and Massage Therapy. Each package includes automated scheduling, customer management, social media posting, and business intelligence. Visit https://ergovia-ai.com/taskforce to explore options.
How much does Ergovia cost?

Ergovia-AI offers: Free Tier - Basic AI assistant with limited usage. Premium Plan - $30/month for unlimited AI conversations, priority support, advanced AI models, and conversation export. ETF TaskForce pricing varies by business type and automation complexity. Upgrade at https://ergovia-ai.lemonsqueezy.com/buy/00ee131b-da5f-4eef-bf32-7c12aa28a11d
What AI models does Ergovia use?

Ergovia-AI supports multiple advanced AI models: GPT-4 Turbo (for complex tasks), GPT-4 (for detailed work), GPT-3.5 Turbo (for quick responses), and DeepSeek Chat (for creative and innovative solutions). The system automatically selects the best model based on your request keywords, or you can specify your preference.
Can Ergovia help with affiliate marketing?

Yes! Ergovia-AI specializes in affiliate marketing support. I can help you: Write compelling product reviews, Create email campaigns, Generate social media captions, Develop landing page content, Plan marketing funnels, Analyze competitor strategies, and Optimize conversion rates. Just ask 'Need help with Affiliate Marketing?' to get started with specific guidance.
What businesses can use Ergovia TaskForce?

Ergovia TaskForce currently supports these business types: 1) Pet Clinics & Veterinary Practices - appointment scheduling, medical records, inventory management 2) Gyms & Fitness Centers - member management, class scheduling, progress tracking 3) Contractors & HVAC - job scheduling, customer follow-ups, invoicing 4) Tutoring Services - student scheduling, progress reports, parent communication 5) Massage Therapy - appointment booking, client management, wellness tracking. Each gets custom automation workflows.
How do I access the TaskForce dashboard?

To access your Ergovia TaskForce dashboard: 1) Log into https://ergovia-ai.com 2) Click 'Ergovia TaskForce' in the sidebar or navigation 3) Or directly visit https://ergovia-ai.com/taskforce 4) For ETF onboarding, go to https://ergovia-ai.com/etf-onboard 5) For client management, visit https://ergovia-ai.com/etf-client-panel. You need to be logged in to access these features.

Ergovia TaskForce (ETF) provides comprehensive automation including: Appointment scheduling and reminders, Customer onboarding workflows, Automated email and SMS campaigns, Social media content posting, Inventory management alerts, Staff training and onboarding, Medical/service record management, Payment processing and invoicing, Business analytics and reporting, Review request automation, and 24/7 customer support chatbots. All running under your business name.
